entities.summary: Paolo Giobbe was an Italian cardinal of the Catholic Church who served as Papal Datary in the Roman Curia from 1959 to 1968, and was elevated to the cardinalate in 1958 as Cardinal-Priest of Santa Maria in Vallicella.
